desc:
Scan passengers. Stop threats. Defend the airport. 🚨 

🔍 Scan passengers with advanced security equipment
🧳 Search luggage for prohibited items
📋 Verify passports and boarding passes
💰 Earn cash and upgrade your gear
🏢 Unlock new airport terminals [SOON]
⚠️ Stop criminals and dangerous travelers!

🔥 The more passengers you process, the more dangerous the airport becomes.

👹 Face powerful boss that attempt to breach airport security
⚔️ Defeat the final threat and save the airport
🏆 Unlock exclusive rewards and achievements

📱 Playable on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console

✈️ Can you become the ultimate Airport Security Chief?
